name: ActionSheet
description: A short list of choices that slides up from the bottom of a phone screen for one thing the person just picked: share, move, delete. Big touch-sized buttons, a separate Cancel, danger actions that ask once more, actions that can wait on a request, and per-person permissions. Open it with DialogTrigger.

title.description: Heading, also the accessible name. Name the thing the actions are about: "Invoice 1042". Without a title, pass aria-label.

description.description: Short supporting text under the title.

actions.description: The choices as data: { id, label, description?, icon?, tone?, onAction, confirm?, permission? }. tone is "default" or "danger". onAction may return a promise: the action shows it is working, the others wait, and the sheet closes when it succeeds or shows the error message when it fails. confirm ({ description?, confirmLabel? }) asks once more before onAction runs. An action may carry a permission ("allow", "disabled", "hidden" or { state, reason }): hidden actions are not drawn; disabled ones stay as focusable, inactive buttons with the reason shown.

showCancel.description: Show the separate Cancel button under the list. Turn it off only when the sheet closes another way people can see, such as a clear backdrop to tap.

onCancel.description: Called when the Cancel button is pressed. To hear about every way the sheet closes (Escape, the backdrop, a drag down), control it with isOpen and onOpenChange.

onError.description: Called with the error when an action's promise rejects, for logging.

labels.description: The words, for translation: { cancel, back, error, working }. cancel is the Cancel button, back returns from the confirmation step, error is shown when an action fails and working is announced while one runs.

portalContainer.description: Draw the sheet and its backdrop inside this element instead of over the whole page. Use it to show a sheet inside a preview, a framed app or a phone mock. The element must be positioned (relative) and clip its overflow.

isDismissable.description: Closes on backdrop click and on a drag down. Esc always closes.

classNames.description: Class names for the parts, by slot name, added after the built-in ones. Slots: list, action, cancel, confirm, error.

keyboard: Tab and Shift+Tab: move through the actions and Cancel; focus stays inside the sheet
Arrow Down and Arrow Up: move between the actions; Home and End go to the first and last
Enter or Space: chooses the focused action
Escape: in the confirmation step goes back to the list; otherwise closes the sheet and returns focus to what opened it
requirements: The sheet is a modal dialog with a name (the title); the page behind cannot be reached and focus returns to the trigger on close
The actions are real buttons in a list, each with a text label; an icon never stands in for it
Each action is at least 48 CSS pixels tall and as wide as the sheet
A danger action is told apart by its words and position as well as its color
A confirmation step names the action and what it does, moves focus into it and can be left with Back or Escape
While an action waits on a request the sheet says so (aria-busy on the list and a status message), the other actions are inactive and a second press does nothing
A failed action keeps the sheet open and shows the error message in an alert, so the person can try again or cancel
A disabled action stays focusable (aria-disabled), does nothing and shows why
The slide is turned off when the user prefers reduced motion
screenReader: "Invoice 1042, dialog", then the list: "Download PDF, button", "Delete invoice, button"
"Delete invoice" asks: "Delete this invoice? This cannot be undone." with "Delete" and "Back" buttons
While working: "Working"; on failure: "Something went wrong. Try again."

use_when: A handful of actions for one item the person just chose, on a phone
Share, move, rename, delete: one choice, then the sheet is gone
A destructive choice that needs one more tap to confirm
avoid_when: More than about 7 actions: use a Drawer with a searchable list, or a different screen
Picking a value for a field: use Select or NativeSelect
Information or a form: use Drawer or Dialog
A wide screen with a mouse: use Menu
anti_patterns: Actions that are not about the item the sheet names
Hiding Cancel while the sheet cannot be closed another way
A confirmation on every action: ask only for the ones that destroy or cost something
Icon-only actions: the label is the name
UI permission is not security: hiding or disabling an action only changes what people see, so the server must check access again for every request
